authorization: User explicitly permits very small risk in exchange for large gain and asks to continue iteration; successful candidates may be pushed under the existing authorization.
selection: Choose one candidate on development cases, freeze before confirmation. Do not tune on confirmation.
small_risk_gate: One-sided exact 95% upper confidence limit of run-level non-full-clear probability <= 0.01 on at least 600 new cases, with no process or protocol errors.
large_gain_gate: At least 10% reduction in paired all-case virtual time per actually cleared source relative to the frozen zero-risk certified_reference, and a positive paired 95% bootstrap interval for saved time.
publication: Publish the selected candidate to a separate risk-budget branch if both gates pass; keep the zero-risk and probabilistic fast references available and disclose failures.
limitations: Model risk assumes independent source locations, uniform reception-radius prior, count and channel assignment model. Empirical risk applies to the offline practice generator, not arbitrary formal datasets.
